outline:
一、現代無線傳輸系統應用介紹。
二、無線傳輸系統雜訊及失真分析模式介紹。
三、無線通訊高頻前端關鍵組件設計技術介紹。
四、高頻微波輻射及傳輸衰落特性介紹。
五、行動寬頻通訊架構，調制技術及系統性能分析介紹。
六、提供從事通信工程人員補充微波工程基本知識，反之亦然。

To introduce the fundamental architecture of modern wireless system.
 To introduce the fundamental characteristics and modals of noise and distortion in radio-frequency wireless systems.
 To introduce the analysis and design of critical components at the radio-frequency front-end stage of wireless system.
 To introduce the fundamental characteristics of radio wave propagation.
 To introduce the analysis of mobile wideband wireless system performance based on system architecture , modulation techniques and radio propagation effect.
 This course is useful to those who work in Electromagnetic but like to supplement their background on communication subjects, and vice versa.
schedule:
Week 1 : Introduction to the Fundamentals on Microwave Communication
Week 2 : Noise and Distortion on wireless radio Link Systems
Week 3 : Wave Transmission on transmission Lines and Waveguides
week 4 : Microwave Netwoks Analysis and Matching Techniques
week 5 : Microwace Couple Line Theory and Power Divider
Week 6 : Rf and Microwave Filters Design
Week 7 : Microwave Oscillator and Frequency Synthesizer
Week 8 : Microwave Amplifier
Week 9 : Min-term Examination
Week 10 : Phenomina of Wave Propagation on Different Media
Week 11 : Wave Propagation and Large-Scale link Budget Prediction
Week 12 : Small-Scale Wave Propagation Fading Channel Analysis
Week 13 : Transmitter Architecture and Parameters
Week 14 : Receiver Architecture and Parameters
Week 15 : System Performance Evaluation with Modulation Techniques
Week 16 : Issues on Updated Wireless Radio-Link Systems (A)
Week 17 : Issues on Updated Wireless Radio-Link Systems (B)
Week 18 : Final Exam.
